-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.RestartNode` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def ApiImpl.restartCt (F : List EntryM) (c : Nat) : List (Nat × w64) :=
  List.map (fun k => (k + 1, (Option.map EntryM.Term' F[k]?).getD (W64 0))) (List.range c)

                      uint.nat cv.Applied' = 0 ∨ σ.b ≤ uint.nat cv.Applied' ∧ uint.nat cv.Applied' ≤ σ.commit →
                        max σ.b (uint.nat cv.Applied') ≤ a →

                                          ∀ nd,
                                            (∃ n S l K,
                                                ⌜nd = interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
